title: Parent-Child Interaction Therapy
tagline: Healing the relationship that heals the child.
welcome: PCIT coaches the parent in the room, live, to become the child's therapist. This course trains you in one of the most powerful evidence-based methods for young children.
vignette: Behind a one-way mirror, a coach whispers into a mother's earbug: 'Catch him doing anything right.' The mother praises; the boy brightens; the cycle turns. In minutes, the relationship is the treatment.
vignette_attr: A live PCIT coaching moment, drawn from practice
description: An intensive course in Parent-Child Interaction Therapy: attachment and social-learning foundations, the CDI phase (PRIDE skills and differential attention), the PDI phase (effective commands and consistent follow-through), live bug-in-the-ear coaching, assessment and progress monitoring, and working with challenging cases.
questions: How do I coach a parent live without shaming them?
How do I sequence warmth before discipline?
How do I hold fidelity to the model with real families?
importance: PCIT has among the strongest evidence for early conduct problems
It changes the parent, which changes the child durably
Live coaching is a uniquely powerful skill
misconceptions: that PCIT is parent training only, when it is relationship therapy in vivo
that it is rigid, when it is mastery-based and individualized
figures: who created PCIT from attachment and learning science
who advanced PCIT training and adaptation
outcomes: You will integrate attachment and social-learning foundations.
You will coach praise, reflection, imitation, description, enjoyment.
You will coach clear commands and consistent follow-through.
You will deliver bug-in-the-ear coaching that builds parents.
You will use standardized session-by-session measurement.
You will handle complexity within fidelity.
modules: Warmth first, and mastery of it.
Timing, shaping, and supporting the parent
assessment: Assessment is fidelity and coaching based.
A recorded coaching segment with fidelity rating
tips: Praise the parent the way you want them to praise
Keep coaching statements short and immediate
Trust the sequence: warmth before structure
integration: PCIT is a flagship method integrating play, family, and behavioral competence.
faith: We strengthen parents as the child's first and lasting healers, honoring the family covenant.
closing: May every parent you coach discover their own power, and every child their parent's warmth.
